en.name: Julius III
en.summary: A pope who reopened the Council of Trent but whose reign became better known for his controversial elevation of a young favorite, Innocenzo.
en.body: Giovanni Maria Ciocchi del Monte reconvened the Council of Trent in 1551 after a lengthy suspension, though further interruptions meant its work would not conclude until well after his death. His pontificate drew persistent criticism for the rapid rise of his adopted "nephew" Innocenzo, a street youth given a cardinal's hat and extensive privileges, fueling contemporary rumors about the nature of their relationship.
